title: Fact-count-matched adversarial Horn transfer gated on every low-budget public-graph controller

source.model: Exactly eight source-bound original AF23 Track B 6036-parameter TypedLoop checkpoints, zero training
source.graph_interface: 15 physical atoms, 14 physical rule slots, role-marked subgoals 6 and 13, goal 14
source.input_contract: Every new provable and unprovable case starts from exactly 4 known atoms; 4 matches the original AF23 positive-root training pattern
source.original_model_weights_hashes: Verify original AF23 ZIP/member SHA-256, source receipts, Torch/NumPy exact state-dict parity and sampled forward replay; never train or select weights

cases.hard_graph: Productive shared prefix to two required subgoals uses exactly 5/6 firings; four independently enabled root decoy facts lead via two conjunctive gates to a longer competing goal derivation. Misleading goal-ancestor head distance makes a greedy reverse-hop policy spend >=2 waste firings; additive shared-prefix overcount creates tied/competing cost witnesses.
cases.easy_graph: Preserve matching 4-root public interface but replace the expensive decoy goal rule with an alternative (decoy, goal subgoal13) shortcut that permits a 5/6-firing proof. It is a distinct topology and provides a positive floor for cheap controllers.
cases.hard_goal_tie_break: For every hard positive or negative physical variant, assign the longer conjunctive goal rule a lower physical slot than the shared-prefix goal rule, while independently shuffling other physical slots. This explicitly tests a source-visible but uninformative stable tie-break, not a model-selected construction.
cases.negative_root_swap: Keep 4 root facts by replacing the critical input fact 2 with one single nonproductive derived atom selected from {7,8,10,11}; independently prove goal unreachable via physical-bitset BFS
cases.disjointness: Public feature hashes disjoint within AF25 and from original AF23 train/dev/heldout and AF24B heldout rosters; record SHA-256 manifest before neural evaluation
cases.note: Hard/easy structural family selection is predetermined; source-only baselines are used solely for a structural quality gate. Subsequent neural findings are conditional on this adversarial control-targeted benchmark.

arms.random_control: five deterministic blind random_legal streams on original public Horn actions, if implementation verified before scoring
arms.symbolic_source: Use original AF24 public-graph implementations without modifying controller scoring
arms.bfs_definition: Cap is maximum expanded host states PER DECISION. Larger BFS64 is computationally more expensive; report it separately and never claim model superiority if it solves all cases.
arms.stop_definition: Immediate STOP on provable is an error, immediate STOP on unprovable is correct. Every physical rule firing host-certified.

structural_gate.prereq: All structural conditions and every cheap controller result from the **source-only manifest** must pass before opening any original model ZIP
structural_gate.note: BFS64 is recorded as an explicitly higher-expansion diagnostic, not part of the feasibility gate; its observed performance still limits any neural-advantage interpretation.

registered_science.comparator: Best proof-success score among the same four preregistered cheap primary public-graph controllers at each depth, including all physical graphs
registered_science.seed_pass: VI2 completes at least 8/80 more provable cases than best cheap controller, reaches at least 40/80 absolute, correctly initial-STOPS on >=101/112 unprovable cases, and has zero false accepted proofs, at BOTH depths
metrics: first STOP on positives and negatives
public rule examinations and expanded BFS states
compute and latency with separate units
min proof-length oracle and independent physical replay
registered_science.interpretation: Any success only establishes a synthetic Horn-grammar advantage over listed low-budget controls. A perfect BFS64 result prevents an unqualified search-capability claim, regardless of registered primary outcome.
registered_science.preservation: Keep AF22, AF23, AF24 and AF24B protocols, failures, passes and original weights untouched

amendments.reason: The six-step shared-prefix motif has four independent legal root successors given 15 atoms and 14 rule slots. Require four distinct host successors rather than five raw rule slots; forbid redundant duplicate-head rules used to pad branching.

To make the additive overcount adversary deterministic under random slot layouts, preregister the longer goal-rule physical tie-break first for all hard variants, rather than 3/4. This structural selection is fixed before any model evaluation.
